description: Tool-calling checks on chat completions (agent profile). Tool checks may use up to 64 output tokens (budget: tool).

checks.title: Forced tool call returns tool_calls with JSON-string arguments

messages.content: What is the weather in Jakarta? Use the tool.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the current weather for a city.

checks.fix_hint: function.arguments must be a JSON-encoded string ("{\"city\":\"Jakarta\"}"), not an object. Upstreams with a native tool format (Anthropic, Gemini) return objects; the gateway must JSON.stringify them. Also honour named tool_choice.

checks.title: Tool result can be sent back (assistant tool_calls + role=tool)
checks.fix_hint: Accept an assistant message with content null plus tool_calls, followed by {role:"tool", tool_call_id, content}. Keep tool_call_id intact when translating to other formats (Anthropic tool_use_id).

checks.title: Streamed tool call: every delta has index, arguments are string fragments

messages.content: What is the weather in Jakarta? Use the tool.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the current weather for a city.

checks.fix_hint: Each delta.tool_calls[] item needs a numeric index (clients merge fragments by index). Send id, type and function.name on the first fragment and function.arguments as string pieces that join into valid JSON.

checks.title: History with assistant tool_calls: null is accepted

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Several agent frameworks replay history with "tool_calls": null on plain assistant turns. A gateway should drop null/empty tool_calls before forwarding instead of returning 400.

checks.title: History with assistant tool_calls: [] is accepted

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Some upstreams (including OpenAI itself) reject an empty tool_calls array. Clients should omit the field; gateways can strip it to be tolerant. A warning here is common and not fatal.
